name: bare-file-logger

exports.name: FileLog
signatures:
interface FileLog {
  append(label: string, ...data: unknown[]): void
  close(): void
  readonly colors: boolean
  format(...data: unknown[]): string
  debug(...data: unknown[]): void
  info(...data: unknown[]): void
  warn(...data: unknown[]): void
  error(...data: unknown[]): void
  fatal(...data: unknown[]): void
  clear(): void
}
exports.description: Construct a new `FileLog` that writes to the file at `path`.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the log file; opened for appending, and created if it does not exist.

params.name: label
params.description: A short severity label, right-padded to five characters (e.g. `info`, `error`), prefixed to the line ahead of an ISO-8601 timestamp.

params.name: data
params.description: Values to format into the log message, using the same formatting as `console.log`.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the underlying file descriptor and stops the rotation timer. Safe to call more than once.

exports.name: FileLogOptions

members.name: maxSize
members.description: The size, in bytes, at which the log file is rotated. Default `0`, which disables rotation.

members.name: rotate
members.description: Given the current log path, returns the path to archive it to before it is rotated. Default `null`, in which case the log is truncated in place. If it throws, rotation falls back to truncation.

members.name: rotateInterval
members.description: How often, in milliseconds, the log size is checked against `maxSize`. Default `2000`.

exports.name: FileLogEvents

members.name: rotate
members.description: Emitted after the log file is rotated, with the log `path` and the archive path, or `null` when the log was truncated in place.
